proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ A B T₁ T₂ H hT h1 h2 hA1 hB1 hA2 hB2 hH hHT
  have t1 : s₁.IsTangentAt T₁ line[ℝ, H, T₁] :=
    ⟨h1.mem_sphere, right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ H T₁, (affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem hHT (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ T₁ T₂)).trans h1.le_orthRadius⟩
  have t2 : s₂.IsTangentAt T₂ line[ℝ, H, T₂] :=
    ⟨h2.mem_sphere, right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ H T₂, (affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem hHT (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ T₁ T₂)).trans h2.le_orthRadius⟩
  have e1 := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.dist_sq_eq_mul_dist_of_tangent_and_secant hA1 hB1 hH t1
  have e2 := EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.dist_sq_eq_mul_dist_of_tangent_and_secant hA2 hB2 hH t2
  have heq : dist H T₁ = dist H T₂ := (sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp (e1.trans e2.symm)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hHT
  rw [← ht, dist_lineMap_left, dist_lineMap_right] at heq
  have hL : dist T₁ T₂ ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hT
  have habs : ‖t‖ = ‖1 - t‖ := mul_right_cancel₀ hL heq
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs] at habs
  have ht12 : t = 1 / 2 := by
    rcases abs_eq_abs.mp habs with h | h <;> linarith
  rw [← ht, ht12]
  simp [midpoint]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (A B T₁ T₂ H : P), T₁ ≠ T₂ → s₁.IsTangentAt T₁ line[ℝ, T₁, T₂] → s₂.IsTangentAt T₂ line[ℝ, T₁, T₂] → A ∈ s₁ → B ∈ s₁ → A ∈ s₂ → B ∈ s₂ → H ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → H ∈ line[ℝ, T₁, T₂] → H = midpoint ℝ T₁ T₂
